title: Balanced coherence of canonical coefficient pullback comparisons
statement: In the setting and notation of def-pur-ringed-coefficient-projection-data, fix already constructed e:Comparisons(g,nY,nX) and multiplication units uY,uX. Then the inverse-image comparisons commute with the balanced scalar associators and multiplication units, precisely PullbackCoherence(g,nY,nX,e,uY,uX). This is a coherence result for already constructed inverse-image/tensor maps; it contains neither construction of e nor a law about its direct-image mate. All scalar, associator, inverse-image and mate shift equations are proved separately.

source.place: Tag 0D6D, common K-flat representatives for pullback composition; explicit balanced double-tensor and scalar multiplication calculations.

proof.text: Represent every input by a common flat-term K-flat complex. The given scalar normalizations provide invertible computation maps, and inverse image preserves the representative class.

Ordinary insertion fixes the scalar/inverse-image comparison uniquely by tensor generation and module-sheafification uniqueness. The two maps around the associator square take t tensor (s tensor x) to b(s)t tensor x. Thus they are equal chain maps. The representative equations identify these maps with the derived composites. Cancel the invertible computation maps and use the chosen resolution to deduce the composition equation on every derived object.

Both scalar unitors are multiplication. The identity comparison and its rings.map_id transport therefore make the unit square commute on ordinary tensors. Descend its equality using the representative equations for e and the units, giving the exact PullbackCoherence.unit equation.
